rows: An Ordinance By The Town Of Clermont To Amend The
Code Of Ordinances Of Clermont, Georgia To Establish
Due Compensation Applicable To Any Telegraph Or
Telephone Company Chartered By The Laws Of This Or
Any Other State By Adopting A New Section 101; To
Provide For Codification; To Repeal Conflicting
Ordinances; To Provide An Adoption Date; To Provide An
Effective Date; And For Other Purposes.
